measurementBoundary: New proofs use real Spring/JWT/MySQL and production Python processing with controlled planner/generation outputs. Closing the 13 cases proves database facts and access boundaries. It does not establish new real-model language/inference coverage or Kaggle platform behavior.
harnessCorrections: Response omits null data; default unauthenticated Security entry point returns 403.
Unified requests must contain its own DTO fields, not direct-chat capability fields.
Second Lab membership keeps Portal admission open to exercise revocation at the target resource.
Scripted draft planner outputs must use OTHER_DRAFT, preserving the real semantic validator.
Disabled resource candidates yield established REFUSED responses; global Admin candidates are denied by the gateway.
